name: mbrd-mobile
description: The Android shell for mbrd (Capacitor). It wraps the same web/ tree the website serves, with no fork of the app code. Its own package, as desktop/ is, so the root keeps no dependency and `npm test` still installs nothing. The version here stays 0.0.0: tools/stamp-version.mjs writes the app's version into android/app/build.gradle, from web/assets/js/version.js.

scripts.sync: node tools/stamp-version.mjs && node tools/stage-web.mjs && cap sync android
